title: Best AI Support Tools for Shopify Stores
intro: Shopify stores have a specific problem: customers ask about order status, stock, and shipping constantly, and that data changes by the minute — so a support tool that trains on a static crawl of your site will confidently give wrong answers about live inventory. These four handle that differently.

entries.blurb: Built with e-commerce integrations and sales-assist use cases specifically in mind — its Lyro AI agent reportedly resolves ~90% of conversations, and the free tier includes real ticketing, not a stripped demo.
Native e-commerce integrations surface order and customer context directly inside conversations, bundled with WhatsApp and Instagram for stores selling through social.

The pick if your Shopify traffic comes through Instagram — comment-to-DM automation turns post engagement directly into a sales conversation, though per-contact pricing needs watching as your list grows.
Fast to launch from a website crawl for FAQ-style questions, but remember: it trains on static content, so wire up live stock/pricing via API rather than trusting a crawled page.
